name: EndeavorRx
description: FDA-authorized video-game treatment designed to improve attention function, played about 25 minutes a day. A doctor or other prescriber must write a prescription.
evidence: First game-based digital therapeutic authorized by the FDA (2020) for pediatric ADHD.

name: EndeavorOTC
description: The adult version of the Endeavor attention-training game, available without a prescription via subscription.
evidence: FDA-authorized (2025) over-the-counter digital therapeutic for adults with ADHD.
